'''Fellon''' was a major port [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]]. A small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fellon base|base]] was located here before being destroyed by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] during the [[Halmad campaign]].<ref name="IF" />
